# `fec_source_catalog`

**FEC source directory**

Source discovery metadata from SpicyDocs' official FEC inventory. Join source_family to fec_collections and fec_source_records to inspect which selected collections have been retained. The catalogue covers API, bulk, legal, agency and other official access paths; each has its own scope.

**Coverage.** Not a range. Every source family in the packaged SpicyDocs official FEC registry, with its official access routes. A listed route does not mean its records were acquired: fec_collections says what was. *(measured 2026-09-28)*

- **Parquet file:** `fec_source_catalog.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `observation_ordinal` | `BIGINT` | Zero-based observation order within this dataset generation. Repeated observations remain separate; this is not a publisher record identifier. |
| `source_family` | `VARCHAR` | Official source-family identifier. Join to fec_collections.source_family or fec_source_records.source_family. |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | Source-family title from the packaged official inventory. |
| `api_routes_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON array of official API routes with the provider's route and pagination metadata. Route presence does not prove successful acquisition. |
| `indexes_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON array of official indexes or discovery entry points listed for this family. |
| `bulk_families_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON array of bulk file families associated with this source family. |
| `references_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON array of reference pages from the packaged source inventory. |
| `catalog_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 digest of the exact packaged official_sources.json bytes used to build this row. |
| `provider_version` | `VARCHAR` | Installed SpicyDocs version supplying the source inventory. |
| `catalogued_at` | `VARCHAR` | Time this catalogue output was built; not the time source data was acquired or last changed. |
| `coverage_note` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit scope limitation: catalogue entries describe routes and do not certify underlying data acquisition or publication. |
